visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short black hair and a red-and-white checkered sleeveless top speaks to the camera in a brightly lit indoor space with a white background and a paper floor lamp. (2) She presents a brown cardboard box with the 'mini matters' logo and two white flower icons, pointing at the branding. (3) The scene cuts to a full-body shot of her wearing the checkered top, a black long skirt with drawstring details, and a beige windbreaker jacket while modeling grey Mary Jane-style shoes. (4) Close-up shots focus on the grey shoes, revealing a knitted texture with flower patterns and a silver flower-shaped buckle. (5) She demonstrates the flexibility and lightness of the shoe by holding it up and then tying the white laces over black socks. (6) She opens the box to reveal red-and-white patterned wrapping paper and takes out another pair of light grey shoes. (7) She holds up a red mesh bag with a lace patch and a blue-and-white checkered scrunchie. (8) She shows her smartphone screen displaying a step counter at 16,054 steps. (9) The final shots show her posing in the outfit and holding the blue scrunchie close to the camera.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A female voice speaks with high energy and clarity in Traditional Chinese, accompanied by an upbeat, rhythmic electronic BGM with a clear drum machine beat. (2) A subtle rustling sound of cardboard is heard as she points to the brand name, coinciding with a brief vocal pause. (3) The BGM maintains a steady, moderate tempo as the speaker's vocal pitch rises while describing the 'knitted texture' of the shoes. (4) A faint 'whoosh' sound effect accompanies a fast visual transition between modeling shots. (5) Vocal arousal increases as she highlights the 'lightness' of the product, with the BGM providing a consistent percussive foundation. (6) Soft paper rustling is heard as she unboxes the second pair, layered beneath her continuous high-density narration. (7) A clear 'ding' sound effect triggers as the discount code is mentioned, marking a shift to a promotional tone with high vocal projection.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Technical Details -> Lifestyle Proof -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote a shoe collaboration between the brands 'mini matters' and 'inooknit' by emphasizing comfort, lightweight design, and aesthetic detail. The presenter uses her personal brand authority to build trust, showing real-world usage (16,000 steps) to validate the product's quality before offering a direct purchasing incentive via a discount code.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct presentation of brand box, discussion of collaboration, and provision of a discount code.
